entries.en: The curator found insect damage on several specimens from Agaricaceae.
entries.zh: 馆员发现几份伞菌科标本上有虫蛀痕迹。

entries.en: Her photographs of Agaricales filled most of the exhibition's first room.
entries.zh: 她拍摄的伞菌目真菌照片占据了展览的第一间房的大部分空间。

entries.en: They moved the young Agathis plants away from the broken window.
entries.zh: 他们把幼小的贝壳杉属植物移离了那扇破窗。

entries.en: The older herbarium kept its Agavaceae collection in two adjoining cupboards.
entries.zh: 那座较老的植物标本馆把龙舌兰科藏品放在两个相邻的柜子里。

entries.en: A blurred photograph made the Agelaius specimen difficult to compare with the others.
entries.zh: 一张模糊的照片使那件黑鹂属标本难以与其他标本比较。

entries.meaningZh: 埃净〔旧面粉漂白剂商品名〕
entries.en: The museum declined a leaking container of Agene from the abandoned mill.
entries.zh: 博物馆拒收了那座废弃磨坊送来的一只泄漏的埃净容器。

entries.en: Rain had flattened the Ageratina plants beside the greenhouse entrance.
entries.zh: 雨把温室入口旁的假藿香蓟属植物打倒了。

entries.en: The museum lent its Agkistrodon specimens for the student's comparative study.
entries.zh: 博物馆借出了蝮蛇属标本，供那名学生作比较研究。

entries.en: She sketched the Aglaomorpha specimen before returning it to the glasshouse.
entries.zh: 她给那株连珠蕨属植物画了速写，然后把它送回玻璃温室。

entries.en: A pot of Aglaonema stood between the two empty chairs.
entries.zh: 两把空椅子之间放着一盆粗肋草属植物。

entries.en: The student's drawings of Agnatha survived the flood inside a sealed folder.
entries.zh: 那名学生画的无颚类脊椎动物图放在密封文件夹里，躲过了洪水。

entries.en: The damaged Agonidae specimens were set aside for closer examination.
entries.zh: 那些受损的八角鱼科标本被放到一旁，等待更仔细的检查。

entries.en: We borrowed a preserved Agonus specimen for the temporary display.
entries.zh: 我们为临时展览借来了一件保存处理过的八角鱼属标本。

entries.en: The researcher postponed her work with Agrobacterium until the equipment was repaired.
entries.zh: 设备修好之前，那位研究者暂缓了涉及植物肥大病菌属的工作。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the Agrostemma before the storm damaged the flowerbed.
entries.zh: 园丁在暴风雨毁坏花坛之前，拍下了麦仙翁的照片。

entries.en: Several pressed Agrostis specimens had slipped from their mounting sheets.
entries.zh: 几份压制的翦股颖属标本从装裱纸上滑落了。

entries.en: The illustrator revised her drawings of Ailuropoda after examining the museum specimens.
entries.zh: 那位插画师查看博物馆标本后，修改了大猫熊属的图画。

entries.en: The older collection housed its Ailuropodidae material in a separate cabinet.
entries.zh: 那批较早的藏品把大猫熊科材料单独存放在一个柜子里。

entries.en: A damaged lens spoiled most of his photographs of Ailurus.
entries.zh: 一枚损坏的镜头毁了他拍摄的小熊猫属动物的大部分照片。

entries.en: The Aizoaceae specimens arrived with their original collecting envelopes intact.
entries.zh: 番杏科标本送到时，原来的采集信封仍完好无损。

entries.en: The faded drawing of Ajaia was restored for the museum's anniversary exhibition.
entries.zh: 那幅褪色的粉红琵鹭属动物图为了博物馆周年展得到了修复。

entries.en: One tray of Akeridae specimens was missing from the shipment.
entries.zh: 那批货物中少了一盘筒螺科标本。

entries.en: The artist could not finish her Alauda drawing without a clearer photograph.
entries.zh: 没有更清晰的照片，那位艺术家就无法完成云雀属动物的图画。

entries.en: The guide compared his sketches with specimens from Alaudidae.
entries.zh: 那位向导把自己的速写与百灵科标本作了比较。

entries.en: They returned to photograph the Albatrellus specimens before the exhibition closed.
entries.zh: 他们在展览结束之前回来拍摄那些地花菌属标本。

entries.en: The laboratory lent its Albuginaceae slides to a neighbouring college.
entries.zh: 实验室把白锈菌科玻片标本借给了邻近的一所学院。

entries.en: A broken drawer delayed access to the Albulidae collection.
entries.zh: 一个坏抽屉使人们无法及时取用狐鳁科藏品。

entries.en: Alca offered to carry the boxes while I held the door open.
entries.zh: 阿尔卡提出搬箱子，我则撑着门。

entries.en: Her painting of Alcea was still unfinished when the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 客人们到来时，她画的蜀葵属植物还没有画完。

entries.en: The photographer donated her Alcedinidae images to the local museum.
entries.zh: 那位摄影师把翠鸟科鸟类照片捐给了当地博物馆。

entries.en: The sculptor requested another view of the Alcelaphus specimen.
entries.zh: 雕塑家请求从另一个角度查看那件狷羚属标本。

entries.en: The students unpacked the Alcidae specimens under the curator's supervision.
entries.zh: 学生们在馆员监督下拆开了海雀科标本的包装。

entries.en: The drawing of Aldrovanda was too small to show the damaged part clearly.
entries.zh: 那幅貉藻属植物图太小了，无法清楚显示受损的部分。

entries.en: A volunteer found the missing photograph of Alectis behind a display board.
entries.zh: 一位志愿者在展板后面找到了那张丢失的丝鲹属鱼类照片。

entries.en: The collector wrapped the Alectoria material separately from the heavier specimens.
entries.zh: 采集者把树发属材料与较重的标本分开包好了。

entries.en: An Alectoris specimen was borrowed for the new illustrated guide.
entries.zh: 一件石鸡属标本被借去用于编制新的图鉴。

entries.en: The museum's largest Alepisaurus specimen would not fit in the temporary case.
entries.zh: 博物馆最大的那件帆蜥鱼属标本放不进临时展柜。

entries.en: The botanist found her lost Aletris sketches inside an old atlas.
entries.zh: 植物学家在一本旧地图册里找到了丢失的粉条儿菜属植物速写。

entries.en: The wind scattered the Aleurites leaves she had arranged for her drawing.
entries.zh: 风吹散了她为作画而摆好的油桐属植物叶片。

entries.en: The technician replaced a cracked slide containing Aleyrodes specimens.
entries.zh: 技术员换掉了一张装有粉虱属标本的破裂载玻片。

entries.en: The Aleyrodidae collection was moved while the old cabinets were repaired.
entries.zh: 旧柜子维修期间，粉虱科藏品被搬到了别处。

entries.en: She placed the Alisma specimen beside her unfinished botanical drawing.
entries.zh: 她把泽泻标本放在尚未完成的植物画旁边。

entries.en: The student sorted the Alismales specimens before beginning the comparison.
entries.zh: 学生开始比较之前，先整理了泽泻目标本。

entries.en: Two sheets of Alismataceae specimens were damaged during the move.
entries.zh: 搬迁时，两张泽泻科标本受损了。

entries.en: The older teaching collection included several boxes devoted to Alismatidae.
entries.zh: 那批较早的教学藏品中，有几个箱子专门存放泽泻亚纲材料。

entries.en: Her study of the old Alliaceae collection was interrupted by the roof repairs.
entries.zh: 屋顶维修打断了她对旧葱科藏品的研究。

entries.en: The gardener found an Alliaria plant beside the broken fence.
entries.zh: 园丁在破篱笆旁发现了一株葱芥属植物。

entries.en: The illustrator checked the Alligatoridae specimens before correcting the final plate.
entries.zh: 插画师查看短吻鳄科标本后，才修改最后一幅图版。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the rain to stop before returning to the Allium bed.
entries.zh: 摄影师等雨停后，才回到种着葱属植物的花圃。

entries.en: A burst pipe damaged the photographs but spared the Aloeaceae specimens.
entries.zh: 水管爆裂毁坏了照片，但芦荟科标本幸免于难。

entries.en: She pressed the Alopecurus material between two clean sheets of paper.
entries.zh: 她把看麦娘属材料压在两张干净的纸之间。

entries.en: The damaged Alopiidae specimen was removed from the public display.
entries.zh: 那件受损的长尾鲨科标本被撤出了公开展览。

entries.en: The photographer waited quietly for a better view of Alouatta.
entries.zh: 摄影师静静等待，以便更清楚地拍到吼猴属动物。

entries.en: An Alpinia specimen lay beside the artist's brushes and water jar.
entries.zh: 一株良姜属植物标本放在画家的画笔和水罐旁。

entries.en: They carried the Alsobia plants indoors while the glasshouse roof was replaced.
entries.zh: 更换玻璃温室屋顶期间，他们把娥索花属植物搬到了室内。

entries.en: His drawing of Alsophila lost much of its detail in the small reproduction.
entries.zh: 他的木沙椤属植物图在缩小复制后，失去了很多细节。

entries.en: The Alstonia collection arrived in three carefully packed wooden boxes.
entries.zh: 鸡骨常山属藏品装在三个仔细包装的木箱里送到了。

entries.en: The conservator removed a loose mounting board from the Alstroemeriaceae display.
entries.zh: 修复员从六出花科展品中取下了一块松动的装裱板。

entries.en: She returned the Alternanthera specimen after finishing the colour study.
entries.zh: 她完成色彩习作后，归还了那株虾钳菜属植物标本。

entries.en: The students photographed the Alytes specimen from three different angles.
entries.zh: 学生们从三个不同角度拍摄了那件产婆蟾属标本。

entries.en: Several Amaranthaceae specimens had been packed with the wrong shipment.
entries.zh: 几份苋科标本被装进了错误的那批货物。

entries.en: The gardener rescued the Amaryllidaceae plants from beneath the fallen shelving.
entries.zh: 园丁把石蒜科植物从倒塌的架子下救了出来。

entries.en: The artist left her Amberboa painting to dry beside the window.
entries.zh: 画家把珀菊属植物画放在窗边晾干。

entries.en: The Ambloplites photographs were missing from the final exhibition folder.
entries.zh: 最后的展览文件夹里缺少钝棘翻车鱼属的照片。

entries.en: A student repaired the stand beneath the Amblyrhynchus model.
entries.zh: 一名学生修好了钝喙蜥属动物模型下面的底座。

entries.en: The old Ambrosiaceae sheets were transferred to protective folders.
entries.zh: 那些旧豚草科标本纸被转移到了保护文件夹中。

entries.en: She borrowed an Ambystoma model for the classroom exhibition.
entries.zh: 她为教室展览借来了一个钝口螈属动物模型。

entries.en: The museum closed the Ambystomatidae display while its lighting was repaired.
entries.zh: 博物馆在维修照明期间关闭了钝口螈科展区。

entries.en: The old Ameiuridae collection occupied an entire row of cupboards.
entries.zh: 那批旧鮰科藏品占了整整一排柜子。

entries.en: The drawing of Ameiurus was returned with several corrections in pencil.
entries.zh: 那幅鮰属鱼类图退回来时，上面有几处铅笔修改。

entries.meaningZh: 葇荑花序植物〔分类用语〕
entries.en: The older herbarium stored its Amentiferae sheets in a separate room.
entries.zh: 那座较老的植物标本馆把葇荑花序植物标本纸存放在单独的房间里。

entries.en: The Amiidae specimen arrived after the exhibition had already opened.
entries.zh: 那件弓鳍科标本送到时，展览已经开幕了。

entries.en: Several Ammodytidae specimens were borrowed for a comparative drawing exercise.
entries.zh: 几件玉筋鱼科标本被借去用于比较绘图练习。

entries.en: The sculptor examined the Ammotragus model before choosing a new base.
entries.zh: 雕塑家查看鬣羊属动物模型后，才选了一块新底座。

entries.en: The students compared the Amniota specimens without removing them from their cases.
entries.zh: 学生们没有把羊膜动物类标本从展柜中取出，就进行了比较。

entries.en: The older teaching collection contained several slides of Amoebida.
entries.zh: 那批较早的教学藏品中有几张阿米巴目玻片标本。

entries.en: The student damaged one of the Amoebina slides while unpacking the box.
entries.zh: 那名学生打开箱子时，损坏了一张变形目玻片标本。

entries.en: Her Amphicarpaea drawings were returned with the pressed specimens.
entries.zh: 她的两型豆属植物图随压制标本一起退回来了。

entries.en: The old museum kept its Amphineura specimens away from the public rooms.
entries.zh: 那座旧博物馆没有把双神经纲标本存放在对公众开放的房间里。

entries.en: A cracked jar delayed the loan of the Amphioxidae specimens.
entries.zh: 一个裂了的罐子延误了文昌鱼科标本的外借。

entries.en: A trace of amphiphile remained on the wall of the flask.
entries.zh: 烧瓶壁上还留有微量的两亲物。

entries.en: The researcher had too little amphiporine left to repeat the comparison.
entries.zh: 那位研究者剩下的纽虫烟硷太少，无法再作一次比较。

entries.en: She waited for a clearer view before photographing the Amphiprion specimens.
entries.zh: 她等视线更清楚后，才拍摄那些双锯鱼属标本。

entries.en: The Amphipsylla specimens were returned in a new protective box.
entries.zh: 双蚤属标本装在一个新的保护盒里退回来了。

entries.en: In the old preparation, the amphipyrenin was no longer clearly visible.
entries.zh: 在那份旧制片中，核膜质已不再清晰可见。

entries.en: The new drawings of Amphisbaenia were larger than the originals.
entries.zh: 新绘制的蚓蜥类图画比原图大。

entries.en: The amphisbaenian disappeared beneath the loose soil before we could photograph it.
entries.zh: 那只蚓蜥钻进了松土里，我们还没来得及给它拍照。

entries.en: The artist requested more time with the Amphisbaenidae specimens.
entries.zh: 画家请求多留一些时间查看蚓蜥科标本。

entries.en: Two damaged Amphisopidae specimens were excluded from the temporary display.
entries.zh: 两件受损的双等足科标本没有放入临时展览。

entries.en: The broken Amphissitidae specimens were returned in separate padded boxes.
entries.zh: 破损的双绿介科标本被分装在带衬垫的箱子里退回了。

entries.en: The old Amphistoma preparation was too damaged for the student's drawing.
entries.zh: 那份旧双口吸虫属制片损坏得太严重，学生无法据此作画。

entries.en: The curator unpacked the Amphistomata material after checking the damaged crate.
entries.zh: 馆员检查过受损的木箱后，拆开了端盘吸虫亚目材料的包装。

entries.en: A tear in the moss section obscured part of the amphithecium.
entries.zh: 苔藓切片上的一处破口遮住了部分蒴周层。

entries.en: The colony's amphitokal reproduction complicated the observer's breeding records.
entries.zh: 该群体的单体两性生殖使观察者的繁殖记录变得复杂。

entries.en: The unmated females provided evidence of amphitoky in the colony.
entries.zh: 那些未交配的雌体为该群体中存在单体两性生殖提供了证据。

entries.en: The observer counted the amphitricha twice because the first tally seemed unreliable.
entries.zh: 第一次计数似乎不可靠，观察者因此把两端鞭毛菌数了两遍。

entries.en: The damaged image made the amphitrichate cells difficult to distinguish.
entries.zh: 图像受损，使那些有两端鞭毛的细胞难以辨认。

entries.en: The illustrator needed a clearer photograph of the amphitrichous bacterium.
entries.zh: 插画师需要一张更清晰的两端鞭毛细菌照片。

entries.meaningZh: 安菲特律特〔希腊神话女神〕
entries.en: In the retelling, Amphitrite waited beside the empty throne.
entries.zh: 在那个改编故事里，安菲特律特在空王座旁等候。

entries.en: The actor playing Amphitryon entered before the musicians had finished.
entries.zh: 扮演安菲特律翁的演员在乐师们演奏完之前就上场了。

entries.en: The Amphiumidae models were moved while the exhibition room was repainted.
entries.zh: 展厅重新刷漆期间，两栖螈科动物模型被搬到了别处。

entries.en: A visitor donated three old drawings of Amphizoidae to the collection.
entries.zh: 一位访客给藏品捐赠了三幅两栖甲科动物的旧图画。

entries.en: The comparison was postponed because the ampho-surfactant shipment had not arrived.
entries.zh: 由于两性表面活性剂还未送到，比较工作推迟了。

entries.en: One amphocyte lay near the damaged edge of the section.
entries.zh: 一枚两染细胞位于切片受损的边缘附近。

entries.en: Her assistant had misplaced the sealed vial of amphomycin.
entries.zh: 她的助手把那瓶密封的双霉素放错了地方。

entries.en: The bottle of amphopeptone was missing from the old laboratory collection.
entries.zh: 那批旧实验室藏品中少了那瓶两性胨。

entries.en: The student overlooked an amphophil near the centre of the image.
entries.zh: 学生漏看了图像中央附近的一枚两染细胞。

entries.en: The amphophilic cells were difficult to examine in the faded section.
entries.zh: 在那份褪色的切片中，两染性细胞很难检查清楚。

entries.en: The larger amphophilic-oxyphil cells were blurred in the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片中较大的嗜酸性两染细胞模糊不清。

entries.en: The observer missed the amphophilous cells near the section's edge.
entries.zh: 观察者漏看了切片边缘附近的两染性细胞。

entries.en: The recording captured the amphoricity of the patient's breathing.
entries.zh: 录音记录下了那位患者呼吸音的空瓮性。

entries.en: The examiner listened again to the amphoriloquy before making further notes.
entries.zh: 检查者再次听了那种空瓮性语音，然后才继续做笔记。

entries.en: The photographer returned the Amphoriscidae specimens after the final session.
entries.zh: 最后一次拍摄结束后，摄影师归还了瓮海绵科标本。

entries.en: A cracked lid prevented the museum from accepting the amphotalide container.
entries.zh: 容器盖子破裂，博物馆因此没有接收那个氨苯酞胺容器。

entries.en: The disputed measurement did not settle the question of amphotericity.
entries.zh: 那项有争议的测量没有解决酸碱兼性的问题。

entries.en: She objected to treating the material's amphoterism as proof of purity.
entries.zh: 她反对把该材料的两性性质当成纯度的证据。

entries.en: The patient struggled to describe the amphoterodiplopia without using hand gestures.
entries.zh: 患者不借助手势，就很难描述自己的两眼复视情况。

entries.en: They disagreed about whether the material was truly amphoterous.
entries.zh: 他们对那种材料是否确实具有酸碱兼性意见不一。

entries.en: Her consultant remained uncertain about the diagnosis of amphotony.
entries.zh: 她的专科医生对交感迷走神经过敏这一诊断仍不确定。

entries.en: The lower amplexicaul leaves were missing from the damaged specimen.
entries.zh: 那件受损标本下部的抱茎叶已经缺失了。

entries.meaningZh: 抱合〔两栖动物求偶行为〕
entries.en: A pair of toads in amplexus remained near the pond's edge.
entries.zh: 一对处于抱合状态的蟾蜍仍待在池塘边。

entries.en: The empty ampoul rolled beneath the cupboard and was forgotten.
entries.zh: 那个空安瓿滚到柜子下面，被遗忘了。

entries.en: The technician found the amprolium container behind the damaged shelving.
entries.zh: 技术员在受损的架子后面找到了氨丙啉容器。

entries.en: The old bottle of amprotropine still had its original wooden stopper.
entries.zh: 那只旧安颇托品药瓶仍带着原来的木塞。

entries.en: The damaged Ampulicidae specimens were photographed before the collection was moved.
entries.zh: 那批藏品搬迁之前，受损的长背泥蜂科标本被拍了照。

entries.en: Two empty ampullae lay in a padded wooden box.
entries.zh: 两个空安瓿放在一个带衬垫的木盒里。

entries.en: A box of Ampullaria specimens arrived without the promised photographs.
entries.zh: 一箱壶螺属标本送到了，但没有附上先前答应提供的照片。

entries.en: The enlarged drawing made the ampullate structure easier to see.
entries.zh: 放大的图画使那处壶腹状结构更容易看清。

entries.en: The specialist reviewed the earlier diagnosis of ampullitis before meeting her.
entries.zh: 专科医生在与她见面之前，审阅了先前的壶腹炎诊断。

entries.en: The ampullula was missing from the student's unfinished anatomical model.
entries.zh: 学生尚未完成的解剖模型中缺少小壶腹。

entries.en: The remaining ampyrone was returned with the unopened containers.
entries.zh: 剩下的氨基安替比林和未开封的容器一起退回了。

entries.en: The researcher postponed the comparison after discovering the missing amsacrine vial.
entries.zh: 发现那瓶安吖啶不见了后，研究者推迟了比较工作。

entries.en: Her Amsinckia drawings were among the few works rescued from the flooded studio.
entries.zh: 她的琴颈草属植物图是从被淹的工作室中抢救出来的少数作品之一。

entries.en: The gardener moved the Amsonia plants before repairing the surrounding paving.
entries.zh: 园丁先移走水甘草，再修补周围的铺路石。

entries.en: The letter from Amtorg arrived after the meeting had ended.
entries.zh: 苏美贸易公司的来信在会议结束后才送到。

entries.en: Amusia made choir rehearsals frustrating for him.
entries.zh: 失歌症使他在合唱排练时感到沮丧。

entries.meaningZh: 美国二战退伍军人协会〔机构名〕
entries.en: The faded Amvets banner was repaired before the veterans' reunion.
entries.zh: 那面褪色的美国二战退伍军人协会旗帜在退伍军人聚会前修补好了。

entries.meaningZh: 美国女医务工作者协会〔机构名〕
entries.en: The American Medical Women's Association (AMWA) sent a letter to the organisers.
entries.zh: 美国女医务工作者协会给组织者发了一封信。

entries.en: The patient described the amyasthenia as her main concern.
entries.zh: 患者说肌无力是她最担忧的问题。

entries.en: The illustrator left the amyasthenic patient's hands unfinished in the drawing.
entries.zh: 插画师没有画完图中那位肌无力患者的双手。

entries.en: The damaged crate contained an unopened bottle of amycetin.
entries.zh: 那个受损的木箱里装着一瓶未开封的友霉素。

entries.en: The conservator photographed the amydricaine container before repairing its broken stand.
entries.zh: 修复员在修理破损底座之前，给戊胺卡因容器拍了照。

entries.en: The lecturer requested permission to photograph the specimen with amyelencephalia.
entries.zh: 讲师请求获准拍摄那件无脑脊髓畸形标本。

entries.en: The old drawing of an amyelencephalus was damaged at the edges.
entries.zh: 那幅无脑脊髓畸胎旧图的边缘受损了。

entries.en: The family requested a second opinion after the diagnosis of amyelia.
entries.zh: 无脊髓畸形的诊断作出后，家属请求另一位医生提供意见。

entries.en: The museum retained the amyelic specimen but replaced its damaged stand.
entries.zh: 博物馆保留了那件无脊髓标本，但更换了受损的底座。

entries.en: He brought his partner to the consultation about amyelineuria.
entries.zh: 他带着伴侣参加了关于脊髓机能缺失的诊疗咨询。

entries.en: The diagram showed a single amyelinic nerve fibre.
entries.zh: 图中显示了一根无髓鞘神经纤维。

entries.en: The consultant questioned the diagnosis of amyeloidemia and requested the original records.
entries.zh: 专科医生对无髓细胞血症的诊断提出了质疑，并要求查看原始记录。

entries.en: Her diagnosis of amyeloneuria complicated the family's plans to move.
entries.zh: 她被诊断出脊髓机能缺失，使全家的搬迁计划变得复杂了。

entries.en: The damaged illustration showed an amyelonic fetus.
entries.zh: 那幅受损的插图中画的是一个无脊髓胎儿。

entries.en: The patient with amyelotrophy asked for the appointment to be postponed.
entries.zh: 那位脊髓萎缩患者请求推迟预约。

entries.en: The illustrator needed another view of the amyelus specimen.
entries.zh: 插画师需要从另一个角度查看那件无脊髓畸胎标本。

entries.en: The old Amygdalaceae collection was stored above the library.
entries.zh: 那批旧扁桃科藏品存放在图书馆楼上。

entries.en: The missing amygdalase shipment forced the researchers to postpone their comparison.
entries.zh: 苦杏仁苷酶未能送到，研究者们不得不推迟比较工作。

entries.en: He cancelled the rehearsal because of amygdalitis.
entries.zh: 他因扁桃体炎取消了排练。

entries.en: The illustrator left the amygdalo-uvular region of the drawing unfinished.
entries.zh: 插画师没有完成图中扁桃体—悬雍垂区域的绘制。

entries.en: The drawing placed the amygdaloncus slightly left of its actual position.
entries.zh: 图中扁桃体瘤的位置比实际位置略偏左。

entries.en: The patient with amygdalopathy waited beside the examination room.
entries.zh: 那位扁桃体病患者在检查室旁等候。

entries.en: The supplier could not locate the missing container of amygdalophenin.
entries.zh: 供应商找不到那个丢失的杏仁酰对乙氧基苯胺容器。

entries.en: The remaining amygdalose was packed separately from the damaged glassware.
entries.zh: 剩下的苦杏仁糖与受损的玻璃器皿分开包装了。

entries.en: The antique amygdalotome was displayed beside its original storage case.
entries.zh: 那把古董扁桃体刀与原来的收纳盒并排展出。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the Amygdalus specimens before returning them to the collection.
entries.zh: 园丁给那些扁桃属标本拍照后，把它们放回了藏品中。

entries.en: The old laboratory still contained a sealed jar of amygdophenin.
entries.zh: 那间旧实验室里仍有一罐密封的杏仁酰对乙氧基苯胺。

entries.en: The researcher set aside the amylacetylene after finding the damaged stopper.
entries.zh: 发现塞子损坏后，研究者把戊基乙炔放到了一旁。

entries.en: The second doctor was unconvinced by the earlier diagnosis of amylaemia.
entries.zh: 第二位医生不信服先前的淀粉血症诊断。

entries.en: The sample of amylan arrived in a dented metal container.
entries.zh: 麦胶样品装在一个凹陷的金属容器里送到了。

entries.en: The technician noticed a crack in the amylbiguanide container.
entries.zh: 技术员注意到戊烷双胍容器上有一条裂缝。

entries.en: The patient with amylemia returned for the agreed follow-up appointment.
entries.zh: 那位淀粉血症患者按约定回来复诊了。

entries.en: The researcher compared the two amylene samples without assuming they were identical.
entries.zh: 研究者比较了两份戊烯样品，没有预先假定它们相同。

entries.en: The old bottle of amylic alcohol had lost its stopper.
entries.zh: 那只盛着戊醇的旧瓶子已经没有了塞子。

entries.en: The conservator found a hardened lump of amylin under the old workbench.
entries.zh: 修复员在旧工作台下发现了一块硬化的糊精。

entries.en: The damaged starch grain left little amyline for the observer to examine.
entries.zh: 那颗淀粉粒受损了，可供观察者检查的淀粉粒纤维素膜所剩无几。

entries.en: The team could not repeat the comparison because the amylit shipment had not arrived.
entries.zh: 麦芽糖化酶还未送到，团队无法重复那次比较。
